status.evidence: According to UK Companies House, Journease Software Limited is currently an active company based in Bristol under company number 05993058.

claims.claim: Financial profiles sourced from FormationData show that Journease Software Limited maintains a total equity figure of £148k.
claims.source: FormationData Director Profile for Timothy John Bryant

claims.claim: Journease Software Limited has established a strategic transport management system integration partnership with the Haulage Exchange platform, which eliminates manual data re-keying and automatically syncs data between platforms for fleets.

The company collaborated in a technical integration partnership with communication provider Esendex to deliver automated communications solutions for the transport industry, which was deployed in a case study for Rhenus Logistics Home Delivery.

The company reports its operational infrastructure details on its corporate site, highlighting a physical headquarters in Bristol, United Kingdom, and an organizational history extending over 25 years.
claims.source: Journease Corporate Website (About Us and Privacy Policy)

claims.claim: The company reports offering a 99.9% uptime service level agreement along with dedicated UK-based support and continuous 24/7 cloud system access.
claims.note: The specific phrase 'continuous 24/7 cloud system access' is unconfirmed on the site, which instead lists 'cloud-based access from anywhere' alongside 24/7 customer self-service portals and 24/7 visibility.
claims.source: Journease Corporate Website (Products, Solutions, and Terms of Service)

claims.claim: The company reports that its Journease Professional plan operates on a secure infrastructure offering a 99.9% platform uptime, according to the official Journease Professional Plan Page.
The company reports the launch of a next-generation platform in 2024 featuring an updated user interface, advanced route optimization analytics, and AI routing capabilities.
claims.note: No source confirms the launch of a next-generation platform in 2024 with these specific features.

claims.claim: An independent customer review published on Capterra indicates that an oil company based in Aberdeen implemented the software as a customized solution to store, locate, and dispatch over 30,000 components across facilities in the North Sea and West Africa.
claims.note: No published source on Capterra explicitly verifies the specific details regarding an oil company in Aberdeen implementing Journease to dispatch over 30,000 components across facilities in the North Sea and West Africa.

claims.claim: The company's standard contractual terms require data processing activities to adhere to UK GDPR frameworks while letting customers retain ownership of input data, as outlined in the official Journease Terms of Service.

A custom software integration announced by Caesar7 enables direct, secure bidirectional data synchronization with the Journease platform via REST API, SOAP Web Services, XML data exchange, or WebSockets without requiring external middleware.
